tools.name: dialect_endpoints
tools.description: Use first: the endpoints anyone may read, each with its name and title. Side effects: none.

tools.name: dialect_read_endpoint
tools.description: Use to read a public endpoint now: each field's question, value, whether it was read sure, why not, and since when (Unix seconds) it has held, plus the last 24 hours summed and its latest changes. A value read unsure is what it leaned to. Side effects: none.

tools.name: dialect_summary
tools.description: Use for how long or how often over a time: each value's sure seconds, share of the window and how many times it was entered, over the last last_s seconds (default a day). Side effects: none.

tools.name: dialect_changes
tools.description: Use to see what changed: each reading that changed a field, newest first, with its value, whether it was read sure and when, over the last last_s seconds (default an hour). Side effects: none.
